content.title: 4 Promotional Villas and Network Works
summary: The construction of four promotional villas in Rouiba, executed under a comprehensive all-trades package (TCE) including integrated roads and utility networks (VRD).
This residential development in Rouiba balances structural execution with site-wide civil works, ensuring robust utility connections and dedicated access routes for each plot.
description: The scope of works comprised reinforced concrete structural framing, interior and exterior masonry, MEP installations, and high-durability architectural finishes. The civil engineering package included the complete installation of roads and utility networks (VRD) to secure independent service connections.

Designed with contemporary massing and clean geometric facades, the villas integrate private outdoor spaces with functional circulation. The site layout optimizes plot boundaries to balance individual privacy with efficient vehicular and pedestrian access.
content.authority: A precise residential programme where structural integrity is matched by civil execution, delivering fully serviced plots and coordinated architectural finishes from foundation to handover.

faq.question: What does the Rouiba residential project consist of?
faq.answer: The project consists of four individual promotional villas in Rouiba, delivered under a complete all-trades package (TCE) including dedicated roads and utility networks (VRD).

faq.question: What was the technical scope of the construction works?
faq.answer: The contract covered reinforced concrete structural works, interior and exterior masonry, MEP installations, architectural finishes, and site-wide civil works for utility connections and access roads.

faq.question: How are the villas configured on-site?
faq.answer: The villas feature contemporary geometric massing, flat roofs, and integrated balconies, arranged to optimize plot boundaries, private outdoor spaces, and vehicular circulation.
